This inspirational song was created from a quote connected to April 3. Each day of the year carries its own reflections and perspective, and these songs explore ideas that can encourage you to continue growing, building, and trusting your path.

Many of the quotes that inspired these songs were originally written between 2016 and 2019 during a time of deep reflection about life, success, purpose, and personal growth. Those thoughts were first shared as short quotes, and years later they began to take on a new form through music.

Each song expands on the meaning behind the original words and explores the ideas more deeply. These songs are about building your life in your own way, trusting your direction, and creating your own definition of success.

Many of the songs on this channel are also inspired by astrology, Human Design, tarot, and personal transformation. These themes explore the cycles of life and the ways people can grow through reflection, awareness, and new perspectives.
